content: Zaburuna saangu lagu to eona Saputuu.

content.text: Tapanamo kalape tasukuru i KAWASANA OPU
tee talaguaka manga lagu kapujia to saromu, e KAWASANA OPU Momalanga;
to tapakoleleaka kaasimu molagina i wakutuu saeona
tee tuaapa Ingkoo ukeniaka pojanjiamu inda momabhotu i wakutuu malo,
poose tatiki gitari sapulu taliana,
tee taoseakea gambusu tee kecapi.
Roonamo Ingkoo, e KAWASANA OPU, upaunde-undeaku tee opea mopadhana ipewaumu;
iaku kusambo-sambo tee opea mopadhana ikarajaamu.
Amaoge mpuu bhari-bharia ipewaumu, e KAWASANA OPU,
amandala mpuu o fikirimu tee amarasai to tamaʼanaia!
Mia mokabhongo-bhongo inda bheamembali amataua,
mia mokurana fikirina inda bheamaʼanaia o giu incia sumai:
Moomini manga mia madhaki atuwu mboomo rumpu,
tee o mia madhaki ahandamo abhari,
maka manga incia sadhaadhaa bheatopabinasa saʼumurua.
Maka Ingkoo i tampa momalanga saʼumurua e KAWASANA OPU.
Roonamo manga musumu, e KAWASANA OPU,
roonamo manga musumu bheabinasa;
tee bhari-bharia mia madhaki bheupapogaa-gaaia.
Maka upamembaliaku kumakaa mboomo karambau,
tee ulaliakaaku mina bhaau to ubarakatiaku.
Mataku akamatamo kandawuna manga musuku,
tee o talingaku arangomo katalona manga mia madhaki mobhaliaku.
Mia mobanara bheatuwu tee akobhake torosu mboomo puuna horomaa,
tee incia bheamaoge mboomo puuna aras i Libanon.
Manga incia mboomo puuna kau ipombula i aroana Bhanuana KAWASANA OPU,
tee ajulu o kaogena i aroana Bhanuana Aulataʼalata.
Moomini akoʼumurumo dhaangiapo uka akobhake,
tee asadhaadhaa asuburu tee amaijo o tawana,
manga miana mobanara sumai apakoleleaka ande o KAWASANA OPU sumai abanara.
Incia o gunu bhatuku, tee sadia apewau moʼadili.

footnotes.text: Saputuu: Eo pitu eona (Saputuu) ipepaliakana manga miana Israel minaaka i parintana Aulataʼala to eo to poniuntoa tee ibaadati.
